answer: A vine growers' summit could renew voting rights at a daily 20-minute dawn assembly held in person. Everyone must stay throughout; observers enforce one account per person and reject account switching. Because attendance is simultaneous, extra identities require extra attendees, not repeated check-ins. Hypothetical example: 12 attacker-controlled identities need 12 distinct people's exclusive 20-minute attendance, totaling 240 person-minutes per day.
